'Your next Runeblade or Lightning attack this turn gets +2{p}.' / 'Create a Lightning Flow token.' / '**Go again**'. Lightning Runeblade Action (non-attack action, so PLAY - effects resolve when the card is played).

PRINTED GO AGAIN IS DELIBERATELY NOT AUTHORED: it appears in printed_keywords and is unconditional (its own line, not 'if <condition>, this gets go again'), so it fires from the card DB keywords field. Re-authoring it as a GAIN effect would be a defect per the corpus convention (see captains_call_red draft note); the SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword shape does not apply because nothing conditions it.

Pump filter: ONE ATTACK_CLASS_IN with classes ['Runeblade', 'Lightning'] rather than the triage's OR(ATTACK_CLASS_IN [Runeblade], CARD_IS_TALENT [Lightning]). Verified against the handler (condition_types.py ~204): it normalises every entry of 'classes' (also accepting class/talent/talents keys) and tests them against _card_traits (~49), which is classes + talents + colour together - its own comment cites exactly this case ('names two TALENTS ... so a classes-only match found neither'). So one condition matches a Runeblade-class attack OR a Lightning-talent attack; the OR wrapper would be redundant. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK reads mod/amount/filter/scope (effect_types.py ~4592); scope defaults to TURN = 'this turn'; one-shot queue consumed by the first matching attack.

Token: CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/amount/player/destination (effect_types.py ~1942); amount 1 explicit for 'a ... token', player defaults to SELF. json/tokens/lightning_flow.json already exists. No destination override - zone routing derives from the token template's subtypes (it is an Aura).

No gaps found.
